import pandas as pd

path = "budget.xlsx"
xl = pd.ExcelFile(path)
print("Sheets:", xl.sheet_names)
for sheet in xl.sheet_names:
    df = pd.read_excel(path, sheet_name=sheet, header=None)
    print(f"\n=== Sheet: {sheet} (shape {df.shape}) ===")
    print(df.to_string())

from openpyxl import load_workbook

wb = load_workbook("budget.xlsx", data_only=True)
print("Sheets:", wb.sheetnames)
for name in wb.sheetnames:
    ws = wb[name]
    print(f"\n=== Sheet: {name} (dims {ws.dimensions}) ===")
    for row in ws.iter_rows(values_only=True):
        print(row)

import zipfile
import re
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

NS = {
    "m": "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main",
    "r": "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships",
}

path = "budget.xlsx"
with zipfile.ZipFile(path) as z:
    names = z.namelist()
    print("ZIP entries:", names)

    # Shared strings
    shared = []
    if "xl/sharedStrings.xml" in names:
        root = ET.fromstring(z.read("xl/sharedStrings.xml"))
        for si in root.findall("m:si", NS):
            text = "".join(t.text or "" for t in si.iter("{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main}t"))
            shared.append(text)
    print("Shared strings count:", len(shared))

    # Workbook sheets and rels
    wb_root = ET.fromstring(z.read("xl/workbook.xml"))
    sheets = [(s.get("name"), s.get("{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships}id"))
              for s in wb_root.find("m:sheets", NS)]
    print("Sheets:", sheets)

    rels_root = ET.fromstring(z.read("xl/_rels/workbook.xml.rels"))
    rel_map = {r.get("Id"): r.get("Target") for r in rels_root}

    def col_to_idx(ref):
        m = re.match(r"([A-Z]+)(\d+)", ref)
        letters = m.group(1)
        idx = 0
        for ch in letters:
            idx = idx * 26 + (ord(ch) - ord("A") + 1)
        return idx - 1

    for name, rid in sheets:
        target = rel_map[rid]
        if not target.startswith("xl/"):
            target = "xl/" + target
        print(f"\n=== Sheet: {name} (file {target}) ===")
        sheet_root = ET.fromstring(z.read(target))
        for row in sheet_root.find("m:sheetData", NS):
            row_num = row.get("r")
            cells = {}
            for c in row.findall("m:c", NS):
                ref = c.get("r")
                t = c.get("t")
                v = c.find("m:v", NS)
                isel = c.find("m:is", NS)
                if t == "s" and v is not None:
                    val = shared[int(v.text)]
                elif t == "inlineStr" and isel is not None:
                    val = "".join(x.text or "" for x in isel.iter("{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main}t"))
                elif v is not None:
                    val = v.text
                else:
                    val = None
                cells[col_to_idx(ref)] = val
            if cells:
                maxcol = max(cells)
                print(row_num, [cells.get(i) for i in range(maxcol + 1)])
